description: This Java class 'SystemUtil' provides utility methods to retrieve system information such as memory usage, total memory, CPU usage, CPU count, disk space usage, and total disk space, using the OSHI library and Java NIO file APIs.

classes.name: SystemUtil
classes.description: A utility class for retrieving system metrics such as memory, CPU, and disk space usage.

methods.name: getMemoryUsage
methods.description: Returns the current memory usage as a percentage, wrapped in an Optional.

methods.name: getTotalMemory
methods.description: Returns the total system memory in bytes, wrapped in an Optional.

methods.name: getCpuUsage
methods.description: Returns the current CPU usage as a percentage, wrapped in an Optional.

methods.name: getCpuCount
methods.description: Returns the number of logical CPU cores, wrapped in an Optional.

methods.name: getDiscSpaceUsage
methods.description: Returns the disk space usage as a percentage for the root filesystem, wrapped in an Optional.

methods.name: getTotalDiscSpace
methods.description: Returns the total disk space in bytes for the root filesystem, wrapped in an Optional.

methods.name: toPercent
methods.description: Converts used and total byte values into a percentage.
